s-1.ptxt: Inspect and Adjust Rain Clearing Mirror

s3.ptxt: Check that when water is sprayed on the mirror surface, it does not form droplets (beads) but forms a thin water film (hydrophilic state).

item.ptxt: Perform the inspection by comparing the left and right sides or by comparing with a normal vehicle such as a new vehicle. The rain clearing effect may be temporarily reduced in the following cases. In any of these cases, the function can be restored by cleaning and exposing the mirror to sunlight.
When vehicle protective wax remover has adhered
When the mirror surface has been touched with bare hands, or dirt on the mirror surface has been wiped off with an oily cloth or equivalent
When the vehicle has been parked for a long time in a place without sunlight, such as an underground parking garage

s3.ptxt: Wash the mirror surface with water to remove mud and dirt.
After cleaning the mirror surface with a soft cloth using car shampoo, glass cleaner or equivalent, rinse off the cleaner with plenty of running water.

item.ptxt: Using a glass water repellent will cause the function to be lost.
Do not rub the mirror surface with a scraper or oil film remover (compound, etc.).
Using silicone-containing car shampoo or glass cleaner will reduce the rain clearing effect.

s3.ptxt: Leave the vehicle outdoors for 3 to 5 hours to expose the mirror surface to ultraviolet light (sunlight).

atten4.ptxt: The silica layer on the mirror surface has an uneven surface, so cleaning alone leaves dirt in the recesses, and sufficient hydrophilic function cannot be achieved. Therefore, expose it to ultraviolet light so that the self-cleaning effect chemically removes the dirt in the recesses.
